subject: A pottery workshop without the wheel
preview_text: An instructor leads the hand-building introduction, with clay and tools included.
headline: A hands-on introduction to pottery
body:
Curious about working with clay by hand?

ClayRoom’s beginner pottery workshop is an instructor-led introduction to hand building. Clay and tools are provided, leaving you free to work directly with the material during the session.

You won’t be using a pottery wheel. The workshop centres specifically on shaping clay by hand, with the instructor leading the introduction and guiding the experience.

Finished pieces are collected from ClayRoom after firing.

If trying pottery by hand appeals, inspect the programme for a closer look at the workshop and its hand-building format.
